title.zh: Philippine Central Bank Curbs Bank Transfers to Major Crypto Platform Coins ph
title.en: Philippine Central Bank Curbs Bank Transfers to Major Crypto Platform Coins ph

current_state.zh: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas partially suspended inbound InstaPay and PESONet bank transfers to DCPay Philippines, the e-money operator of leading local crypto platform Coins.ph, while outbound transfers and the separately licensed Betur Inc. trading entity remain unaffected.
current_state.en: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas partially suspended inbound InstaPay and PESONet bank transfers to DCPay Philippines, the e-money operator of leading local crypto platform Coins.ph, while outbound transfers and the separately licensed Betur Inc. trading entity remain unaffected.
